Because the jade burn is logged at the raven settlement, the cipher audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 90% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 150 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
